flagged_fields.back_translation: Full tax refunds as business credit

flagged_fields.source: Decline on the basis of the fare rules
flagged_fields.zh: 根据票价规则的下降
flagged_fields.back_translation: Decreases according to fare rules

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the refunds team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到退款团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to refund team

flagged_fields.source: Refund to a card that has since expired
flagged_fields.zh: 退款到已经过期的卡
flagged_fields.back_translation: Refunds to expired cards

flagged_fields.source: My refund of three hundred and fifty-five pounds on booking PL2260 is going back to a card that expired in June. That card no longer exists.
flagged_fields.zh: 我在PL2260预订的355英的退款将返回到六月份过期的卡.这张卡片已经不存在了.
flagged_fields.back_translation: The £355 refund I booked on PL2260 will be returned to a card that expired in June. This card no longer exists.

flagged_fields.source: Send it somewhere it will actually arrive. If it has to go to the old card, explain what happens to it then.
flagged_fields.zh: 发送到它实际上会到达的地方.如果它必须去旧卡, 解释它会发生什么.
flagged_fields.back_translation: If it had to go to the old card, explain what would happen to it.

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the refunds team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到退款团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to refund team

flagged_fields.source: Cancelling a package after the hotel changed
flagged_fields.zh: 在酒店更改后取消套餐
flagged_fields.back_translation: Cancellation of packages after changing hotels

flagged_fields.source: My package booking PK-31908 has had the hotel changed to a different one six kilometres further out. I chose the original for its location.
flagged_fields.zh: 我的包裹预订PK-31908已经有酒店更换到另一个六公里外.我选择了原版的位置.
flagged_fields.back_translation: My package reservation PK-31908 had already been changed to another hotel six kilometers away.

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the packages team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到包裹团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to Package Team

flagged_fields.source: Cannot reset a password with no access to the old email
flagged_fields.zh: 在无法访问旧邮件的情况下无法重置密码
flagged_fields.back_translation: Password cannot be reset when old mail cannot be accessed

flagged_fields.source: Change the email to my personal one and get me back in. Tell me what you need from me to do that.
flagged_fields.zh: 把电子邮件改成我的个人邮件,让我回来.告诉我你需要我做什么来做到这一点.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Tell me what you need me to do to make this happen.

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the loyalty programme team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到忠诚计划团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to Loyalty Program team

flagged_fields.source: Correct the name free of charge and reissue the ticket
flagged_fields.zh: 免费纠正姓名并重新发行机票
flagged_fields.back_translation: Free name correction and reissue of tickets

flagged_fields.source: Company travel profile applied to a personal trip
flagged_fields.zh: 适用于个人旅行的公司旅行概况
flagged_fields.back_translation: Corporate travel profiles for personal travel

flagged_fields.source: Booking JR2231 has gone onto my company's billing account, but this is a personal holiday and should be on my own card.
flagged_fields.zh: 预订JR2231已经转到我公司的账户, 但这是个人的假期,
flagged_fields.back_translation: The reservation for JR2231 has been transferred to my company's account, but it's a personal vacation, and I'm not sure I'll be able to afford it.

flagged_fields.source: Detach the corporate profile as the default
flagged_fields.zh: 将企业配置文件作为默认配置文件
flagged_fields.back_translation: Set the enterprise configuration file as the default configuration file

flagged_fields.source: Advise settling the charge through the company expense process
flagged_fields.zh: 建议通过公司的费用流程来解决费用
flagged_fields.back_translation: Advised to resolve costs through the company's fee process

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the corporate travel team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到公司旅行团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to Corporate Travel Team

flagged_fields.source: Overage charge for API calls above the included quota
flagged_fields.zh: 超过所包含的配额的API通话超额收费
flagged_fields.back_translation: Excess charges for API calls in excess of the quota included

flagged_fields.source: Project PR-5518, plan includes 500,000 API calls per month; 812,000 were recorded, producing an overage of 156.00. A retry loop in the customer's integration generated roughly 300,000 duplicate calls. The agent can waive one overage per account per year.
flagged_fields.zh: 项目PR-5518,计划包括每月500,000个API调用;记录了812,000个,产生了156.00个超值.在客户的整合中重试循环产生了大约30万个重复呼叫.经纪人每年可以放弃一个账户的过剩.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Project PR-5518, the plan included 500,000 API calls per month; 812,000 were logged, resulting in 156.00 overvalues. The retry cycle in client integration resulted in approximately 300,000 repeat calls.

flagged_fields.source: Project PR-5518 has a hundred and fifty-six pound overage charge on it for API calls. We have never gone over the included quota before.
flagged_fields.zh: 项目PR-5518有156英的过剩费用,我们从来没有超过过包含的配额.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Project PR-5518 had a surplus of £156 and we never exceeded the quota included.

flagged_fields.source: We found a retry loop in our integration that repeated the same request for about two days. It was our bug, but nothing useful came of those calls.
flagged_fields.zh: 我们在整合中发现了一个重试循环,这是我们的漏洞, 但这些电话没有什么有用的结果.
flagged_fields.back_translation: We found a loophole in the integration, which is our loophole, but the calls didn't produce anything useful.

flagged_fields.source: We have fixed it on our side. Is there any relief available for a first occurrence like this, and what would it take?
flagged_fields.zh: 我们已经把它修好了.对于第一次发生这种情况, 有没有任何缓解可用, 需要什么?
flagged_fields.back_translation: We've already fixed it.Is there any mitigation available for the first time this has happened, what is needed?

flagged_fields.source: Waive the overage under the annual first-occurrence allowance
flagged_fields.zh: 免除年度首次发生津贴的过剩
flagged_fields.back_translation: Exemption from the first surplus allowance of the year

flagged_fields.source: Charge the overage and enable a usage alert
flagged_fields.zh: 充电过量并启用使用警报
flagged_fields.back_translation: Overcharging and activation of use alarms

flagged_fields.source: Apply a partial credit for the duplicate calls
flagged_fields.zh: 应用于重复呼叫的部分信用
flagged_fields.back_translation: Partial credit applied to repeat calls

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the billing team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到计费团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to billing team

flagged_fields.source: The number is showing in the billing settings, so it reached you. It just does not seem to be doing anything to the invoices.
flagged_fields.zh: 电话号码显示在账单设置中,它似乎对发票没有任何影响.
flagged_fields.back_translation: The phone number is displayed in the account settings, and it doesn't seem to have any effect on the invoice.

flagged_fields.source: Validate the number and credit the tax charged
flagged_fields.zh: 验证号码并扣除收取的税款
flagged_fields.back_translation: Verification number and deduction of taxes collected

flagged_fields.source: Validate the number for future invoices only
flagged_fields.zh: 仅对未来的发票进行验证
flagged_fields.back_translation: Verify only future invoices

flagged_fields.source: Account AC-91002 was charged eighty-nine pounds when our trial ended. I did not know the trial was even close to expiring at all.
flagged_fields.zh: 当我们的审判结束时,账户AC-91002被收取了89英.我甚至不知道审判是否即将到期.
flagged_fields.back_translation: When our trial ended, the account AC-91002 was charged £89.

flagged_fields.source: Nobody on the team logged in after the first week, so we got no value from it at all. The signup address was a colleague who has since left.
flagged_fields.zh: 团队中没有人在第一周后登录, 所以我们从中没有任何价值.报名地址是一个已经离开的同事.
flagged_fields.back_translation: No one in the team signed up after the first week, so we got nothing out of it.

flagged_fields.source: Refund the charge and cancel the plan. If you cannot refund it, say so now rather than after I have waited a week.
flagged_fields.zh: 退还费用并取消计划.如果您不能退还,请现在说,而不是我等了一周后.
flagged_fields.back_translation: If you can't get a refund, please tell me now, instead of me waiting a week later.

flagged_fields.source: Refund the first period and cancel the plan
flagged_fields.zh: 退还第一期并取消计划
flagged_fields.back_translation: Repayment of the first instalment and cancellation of the plan

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the billing team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到计费团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to billing team

flagged_fields.source: The contract we hold states the rate is fixed for the term, and we have six months of it left to run. Nobody contacted us about a change.
flagged_fields.zh: 我们签订的合同规定, 利率是固定的, 我们还有六个月的时间.没有人与我们联系,
flagged_fields.back_translation: We had a fixed interest rate in our contract, and we had six months to go.

flagged_fields.source: Put the price back to the contracted rate and credit what we have overpaid since September. Confirm both of those before we finish.
flagged_fields.zh: 让价格恢复到合同价格, 并认可我们自9月以来所支付的费用.在我们完成之前确认两者.
flagged_fields.back_translation: We've got to get the price back to the contract price, and we've got to acknowledge the costs we've paid since September, and we've got to acknowledge both before we're done.

flagged_fields.source: Restore the contracted rate and credit the overcharge
flagged_fields.zh: 恢复合同的利率和额外的费用
flagged_fields.back_translation: Interest rates and additional costs for the renewal of the contract

flagged_fields.source: Apply the contracted rate going forward only
flagged_fields.zh: 仅在未来使用合同利率
flagged_fields.back_translation: Use contractual interest rates only in the future

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the contracts team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到合同团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to contract team

flagged_fields.source: Refund RF-30055 for six hundred and forty pounds was approved twenty-two days ago. Your team said ten working days and nothing has arrived.
flagged_fields.zh: 六百四十英的退款RF-30055已于22天前获得批准.你的团队说十个工作日, 什么都没有到来.
flagged_fields.back_translation: The refund of 640 pounds RF-30055 was approved 22 days ago.

flagged_fields.source: Take our current bank details and reissue it today. Tell me when the money will actually be with us, to the day.
flagged_fields.zh: 我们现在的银行详细信息, 今天再发行.告诉我当这笔钱实际上会在我们身边,到那一天.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Tell me when this money will actually be around us, until that day.

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the finance team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到财务团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to finance team

flagged_fields.source: Nobody in organisation OR-6640 can sign in. We authenticate with our identity provider and get sent straight back to your login page.
flagged_fields.zh: 没有一个OR-6640组织的人可以登录.然后直接返回您的登录页面.
flagged_fields.back_translation: No one in OR-6640 organization can log in. Then go directly back to your login page.

flagged_fields.source: Fix the login and get at least our admins back in today. Forty people cannot do any work at all until this is resolved.
flagged_fields.zh: 修复登录, 至少让我们的管理员今天回来.在这个问题得到解决之前,
flagged_fields.back_translation: I'm going to try to fix the login, but at least let our administrators come back today.

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the identity engineering team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到身份工程团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to Identity Engineering Team

flagged_fields.source: Reports show stale data
flagged_fields.zh: 报告显示过时的数据
flagged_fields.back_translation: Report shows outdated data

flagged_fields.source: Workspace WS-1193. Dashboard figures are 36 hours behind live records because the nightly aggregation job has failed for two consecutive nights on a schema change. The agent can trigger a manual rebuild and can provide a live query export.
flagged_fields.zh: 工作区WS-1193.因为夜间聚合任务连续两天失败,该代理可以触发手动重建,并可以提供实时查询输出.
flagged_fields.back_translation: The agent can trigger a manual rebuild and can provide real-time query output due to two consecutive days of failed night aggregation missions.

flagged_fields.source: Rebuild the data and get me an accurate figure for yesterday before lunchtime. Our board meeting is at four and I present these numbers.
flagged_fields.zh: 重建数据并给我准确的数字昨天在午餐之前.我们的董事会在四点开会,
flagged_fields.back_translation: Our board of directors met at four o'clock, and we had no time to reconstruct the data and give me the exact numbers before lunch yesterday.

flagged_fields.source: Provide a live query export for the missing period
flagged_fields.zh: 提供缺失期的实时查询导出
flagged_fields.back_translation: Provides real-time query output for missed periods

flagged_fields.source: Confirm the failure and register an incident
flagged_fields.zh: 确认故障并记录一个事件
flagged_fields.back_translation: Confirm a fault and record an event

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the data platform team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到数据平台团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to Data Platform team

flagged_fields.source: File uploads failing above a size threshold
flagged_fields.zh: 文件上传未能超过一个大小值
flagged_fields.back_translation: Failed to upload more than one file size

flagged_fields.source: Small files go through fine. The ones failing are video files between about a hundred and four hundred megabytes, which we need to share with clients.
flagged_fields.zh: 小档案可以通过.我们需要与客户共享的视频文件.
flagged_fields.back_translation: We need video files that we can share with our clients.

flagged_fields.source: Tell me what the actual limit is and how we work with files this size. A plain answer is more useful than another retry.
flagged_fields.zh: 告诉我实际的限制是什么以及我们如何处理这样大小的文件.一个简单的答案比再次尝试更有用.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Tell me what the actual limitations are and how we can handle a file of this size.

flagged_fields.source: Recommend a plan whose limit covers the file sizes
flagged_fields.zh: 推一个限制文件大小的计划
flagged_fields.back_translation: Push a plan to limit file sizes

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the platform engineering team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到平台工程团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to Platform Engineering Team

flagged_fields.source: Workspace WS-9910 on the Business tier at 45.00 per user, renewing in six days with 40 users. The Standard tier at 22.00 lacks the audit log and advanced permissions. The agent can schedule the downgrade at renewal and cannot downgrade mid-term.
flagged_fields.zh: 工作空间WS-9910在商业层45.00每用户,在六天内更新40个用户.没有审计日志和高级权限.经纪人可以在更新时安排降级,而不能在中期降级.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Workspace WS-9910 at business level $45.00 per user, updated by 40 users in six days. No audit logs and advanced privileges. Brokers can arrange downgrades at the time of the update, not in the middle.

flagged_fields.source: Workspace WS-9910 renews in six days on the Business tier at forty-five pounds a user. With forty users that is more than we can justify.
flagged_fields.zh: 工作空间WS-9910将在6天内以每位用户45英的价格更新.对于40名用户来说,
flagged_fields.back_translation: Workspace WS-9910 will be updated within 6 days at a cost of £45 per user.

flagged_fields.source: We use almost none of the advanced features. The one thing we would miss is granular permissions, which I understand is not in Standard.
flagged_fields.zh: 我们几乎不使用任何高级功能.我知道在标准中没有这样的权限.
flagged_fields.back_translation: We hardly use any advanced features. I know that there is no such permission in the standard.

flagged_fields.source: Move us to Standard at renewal. Tell me what we lose the day it changes so I can warn the team in advance.
flagged_fields.zh: 在更新时将我们转移到标准.我可以提前警告团队.
flagged_fields.back_translation: I can warn the team in advance.

flagged_fields.source: Schedule the downgrade at renewal and list the features lost
flagged_fields.zh: 在更新时安排降级并列出丢失的功能
flagged_fields.back_translation: Schedule downgrades and list missing features when updating

flagged_fields.source: Apply a discount to retain the current tier
flagged_fields.zh: 应用折扣以保持当前级别
flagged_fields.back_translation: Apply discounts to maintain current levels

flagged_fields.source: Reduce seat count instead of downgrading tier
flagged_fields.zh: 减少座位数,而不是降级
flagged_fields.back_translation: Reducing the number of seats, not downgrading

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the accounts team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到账户团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgrade to account team

flagged_fields.source: I am the finance contact and I pay the invoices, but my account is a standard member with no admin rights at all on the workspace.
flagged_fields.zh: 我是财务联系人, 我支付账单,
flagged_fields.back_translation: I'm the financial contact, I pay the bills, I pay the bills.

flagged_fields.source: Transfer administration to me. Tell me exactly what proof you need, where to send it, and how long the whole thing takes.
flagged_fields.zh: 把管理权交给我.告诉我你需要什么样的证据, 送到哪里, 整件事需要多长时间.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Tell me what kind of proof you need, where to send it, how long it will take.

flagged_fields.source: Start the admin transfer with domain ownership verification
flagged_fields.zh: 通过域名所有权验证启动管理员转移
flagged_fields.back_translation: Initiate administrator transfers by verifying domain name ownership

flagged_fields.source: Require a written request on company letterhead
flagged_fields.zh: 需要在公司的信封上提出书面请求
flagged_fields.back_translation: A written request must be made on the company's envelope.

flagged_fields.source: Grant temporary elevated access pending verification
flagged_fields.zh: 在等待验证时,授予临时升级访问权限
flagged_fields.back_translation: Granting temporary upgrade access while waiting for validation

flagged_fields.source: I have lost the phone with my two-factor app on it and I cannot get into my account ending 3320. I never saved the recovery codes.
flagged_fields.zh: 我失去了手机上的二元应用程序, 无法登录3320号账户.我从来没有保存过恢复代码.
flagged_fields.back_translation: I lost the binary app on my phone and couldn't log in to my 3320 account. I never saved the recovery code.

flagged_fields.source: There is an old workspace from a team that set one up years ago. Nobody who created it still works here, as far as we can tell.
flagged_fields.zh: 这里有一间旧的工作场所,没有人创造它仍然在这里工作,据我们所知.
flagged_fields.back_translation: There's an old workplace that no one created that still works here, as far as we know.

flagged_fields.source: Merge the legacy workspace into the current organisation
flagged_fields.zh: 将传统工作空间合并到当前组织中
flagged_fields.back_translation: Integrating traditional workspaces into current organizations

flagged_fields.source: Estimated bill far above actual usage
flagged_fields.zh: 估计的费用远远高于实际使用
flagged_fields.back_translation: The estimated cost is much higher than the actual use.

flagged_fields.source: The bill says estimated at the top. I have just read the meter myself and it stands at 41,206, which is far below what you have assumed.
flagged_fields.zh: 账单上写着估计在顶部.我自己刚刚看了计时器, 显示为41,206, 远远低于您的预期.
flagged_fields.back_translation: I've just looked at the timer myself, and it says 41,206, which is way below what you'd expect.

flagged_fields.source: Rebill me on the real reading. Tell me what the corrected amount is before you take anything else by direct debit this month.
flagged_fields.zh: 在真正的读数上再向我收费.在你本月通过直接借款收取任何其他款项之前, 告诉我修正后的金额是多少.
flagged_fields.back_translation: Before you collect any more money this month through direct borrowing, tell me what the revised amount is.

flagged_fields.source: Rebill on the validated customer reading
flagged_fields.zh: 在验证的客户读数上重新计费
flagged_fields.back_translation: Recharging on verified customer readings

flagged_fields.source: Book a meter reading visit before rebilling
flagged_fields.zh: 在重新收费之前预订计数检查
flagged_fields.back_translation: Book a meter check before charging again

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the billing team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到计费团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to billing team

flagged_fields.source: Standing charge billed twice after a tariff change
flagged_fields.zh: 在关税变更后收取两次常规费用
flagged_fields.back_translation: Two routine charges after tariff changes

flagged_fields.source: My gas bill on account UT-7719 has two standing charges running at the same time for part of the month. It adds a few pounds on top.
flagged_fields.zh: 我在UT-7719账户上的汽油账单有两个连续的充电,它增加了几磅的顶部.
flagged_fields.back_translation: My gas bill on the UT-7719 account had two consecutive charges, and it added a few pounds to the top.

flagged_fields.source: I changed tariff on the fifteenth, and it looks like both the old and new standing charges are being applied across that period.
flagged_fields.zh: 我在15日改变了关税, 看来旧的和新的常设费用都适用于这一时期.
flagged_fields.back_translation: I changed the tariffs on the 15th, and it seems that both the old and the new regular charges apply to this period.

flagged_fields.source: Correct it and send me a clean bill. It is a small amount, but I want the document to be right on my record.
flagged_fields.zh: 纠正它并给我一个干净的账单.这是一笔很小的金额,
flagged_fields.back_translation: It's a small amount of money, but it's a lot of money, and it's a lot of money, and it's a lot of money, but it's a lot of money, and it's a lot of money, and it's a lot of money, and it's a lot of money.

flagged_fields.source: Correct the overlap and reissue the bill
flagged_fields.zh: 纠正重叠并重新发行账单
flagged_fields.back_translation: Correcting overlaps and reissuing invoices

flagged_fields.source: Credit the duplicated charge on the next bill
flagged_fields.zh: 在下一张账单上记入重复的费用
flagged_fields.back_translation: Repeated expenses on the next bill

flagged_fields.source: Review the tariff change dates before correcting
flagged_fields.zh: 在纠正之前审查关税变更日期
flagged_fields.back_translation: Date of tariff change reviewed prior to correction

flagged_fields.source: Escalate to the billing team
flagged_fields.zh: 升级到计费团队
flagged_fields.back_translation: Upgraded to billing team

flagged_fields.source: Back-billed for eighteen months
flagged_fields.zh: 在18个月内退账
flagged_fields.back_translation: Repayment within 18 months

flagged_fields.source: I have received a catch-up bill for nine hundred and sixty pounds on account UT-5528, covering eighteen months of under-billing I knew nothing about.
flagged_fields.zh: 我已经收到一个追赶账单九百六十英的账户UT-5528,
flagged_fields.back_translation: I've received a follow up bill for nine hundred and sixty pounds from account UT-5528.

flagged_fields.source: Recalculate what you can actually charge me and set up a payment plan for the rest. I cannot pay this in one go.
flagged_fields.zh: 再计算一下你能收取多少, 并为其余部分制定支付计划.我不能一次性付出这笔钱.
flagged_fields.back_translation: And then calculate how much you can charge, and make a payment plan for the rest.
